messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — BrightBank asked for a POC. They want devs on Hosted API keys, a Dedicated pool for load testing, and a Private/VPC deployment for final validation. Need guidance on RBAC/invite steps and least-privilege for POC engineers. timeline? :calendar:

maria_se: Thanks Alex. Key things: 1) devs can use hosted API keys for sandboxing immediately; 2) Dedicated pool provisioning takes a few days; 3) VPC/private requires infra ticket + security review.

sam_platform: Quick inventory: for Dedicated we need pool size, GPU type preference, and expected qps. Lead time ~3 business days after infra approval. For Private VPC we need CIDR, egress rules, and whether they'll use our control plane or fully on-prem.

alex_sales: They want a small dedicated pool (2 GPUs, A10G-ish), ~200 qps peak for 2h load tests. For VPC they prefer Redwood control plane with customer VPC peering. CIDR to come.

nina_security: From security POV: mandatory SSO (SAML/SCIM) for dev accounts, KMS integration for model keys, and audit logs enabled. We need to send them our data flow diagram and ask for their firewall rules. Also ask whether they need HSM-backed keys.

jon_prodeng: For RBAC we usually provision 3 roles for POC: "poc_viewer" (read-only dashboards + logs), "poc_operator" (can start/stop dedicated pools, rotate keys), and "poc_admin" (full config + rollout). Recommend giving devs poc_operator for the load test only, then drop to poc_viewer.

alex_sales: Can we do ephemeral API keys for devs during the POC (rotation/TTL)? They asked specifically to avoid sharing long-lived keys with contractors.

sam_platform: Yes — we support ephemeral tokens via the tokens service. Default TTL = 1h, can be extended to 8h with justification. For CI/service accounts use scoped service tokens pinned to a single workspace and model. We can provide a script:```bash
# generate ephemeral token
redwood tokens create --workspace brightbank-poc --ttl 3600 --scopes generate:models,read:logs
```

maria_se: Helpful. Also need to confirm least-priv privileges for service accounts used by their automation. Suggest scope list: generate, embeddings:create, logs:read. No billing or admin scopes.

nina_security: Add requirement: all service accounts must have key rotation enabled and an owner in their org. We'll validate via the security questionnaire. I'll attach the questionnaire to the ticket.

alex_sales: What about invites — can we bulk-invite the POC team with role assignment? They have ~12 engineers and 3 contractors.

jon_prodeng: Yes, console supports CSV bulk invites + role column. Contractors should get contractor role that maps to poc_viewer by default. For contractors that need operator perms for the 2h test, we can create a time-limited guest group and automatically downgrade after the window.

sam_platform: Operational checklist for this POC: 1) Create workspace brightbank-poc (owner: Alex) 2) Bulk invite users with SCIM sync or CSV 3) Create dedicated pool request ticket (size + GPU) 4) Configure ephemeral token endpoint for dev tooling 5) Provision KMS and enable audit logs 6) Schedule load test and set rollback policy. I'll open infra task for step 3 after Alex confirms pool size.

alex_sales: Confirm pool = 2x A10G, burst to 4 for 30 minutes, expected test window next Wed 10am PST. Go ahead and open ticket.

sam_platform: Ticket opened: INFRA-2892. Devops assignee @jon_prodeng. ETA 72 hrs. deploy-bot: INFRA-2892 created by sam_platform — priority P1 (POC).

jon_prodeng: For RBAC automation I'll create two groups: brightbank-poc-operators (ttl 2h elevated) and brightbank-poc-dev (operator->viewer after test). Will attach audit webhook.

nina_security: I'll start the security questionnaire; @alex_sales please gather the CIDR and whether BrightBank requires HSM. Also need their incident response contact.

alex_sales: Got it. I'll ping them now and update this thread with CIDR + contacts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria_se: Also flag pricing note — since they will spin a Dedicated pool and use burst, please confirm we bill the dedicated commit vs burst usage. I'll follow up with pricing breakdown in the thread once we have expected hours.

alex_sales: noted — please add rough cost estimate once you have it.

sam_platform: One more: if they want full private deployment (control plane in their VPC), lead time is 4-6 weeks. For this POC recommend control-plane-managed VPC peering to speed things up.

alex_sales: Agreed. We'll proceed with control-plane peering for the POC. I'll update once I have CIDR and contractor list. Thanks everyone.
